entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
By filing the instant writ petition, petitioner has prayed for the following reliefs :
"(i) To issuance of Writ, Order or Direction in the nature of Certiorari/ Mandamus,
commanding and directing the respondent to pay Rs.8,70,000=00 (Rupees eight lacs seventy thousand only) Compensation with capitalized income of admitted 30 matured palm trees to the petitioner which have been cut down by the respondent during the course of acquisition /using the land of the petitioner in order to raising and strengthening the Embankment.

The detailed is being given at paragraph no.23 of this petition;
(ii) in consequence be further pleased to direct the respondent to pay Rs.9,30,160/- (Rupees nine lacs thirty thousand one hundred sixty only) by way of solatium of the acquired/used land which the respondent has taken under the BiharRaiyati Land Lease Niti, 2014, in view of section-30 read with Patna High Court CWJC No.4059 of 2018(5) dt.03-01-2025 section 104 and sub section 1 of section 2 of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:

sentences.text:
by the respondents vide Cheque No. 000046 dated 11.03.2017 of UCO Bank, Phulwari Sharif Branch, Patna after disposal of M.J.C. No.2582 of 2014;
(iii) in consequence be further pleased to direct the respondent to pay Rs.13,14,020/- (Rupees thirteen lacs fourteen thousand twenty only) to the petitioner by way of compensation of soil of the land which were used during raising and strengthening of the embankment by digging the land 10.50 decimals in plot no.3242 and 4.32 decimals in plot no.2460 total 14.82 decimals in both plots up to 6 feet deep which also affected and cause injury/damage the remaining 72.43 decimals in all three plots.
Two supplementary affidavits have been filed on behalf of the petitioner.

In the 1 st supplementary affidavit, it has Patna High Court CWJC No.4059 of 2018(5) dt.03-01-2025 been admitted that due to inadvertence and mistake some relevant facts has not been brought on record.

In para-5 thereof, it is stated that by Annexure-15 (wrongly written as Annexure- 14) at running page 57 of the writ application, the petitioner filed a Compensation Claim Case before the Collector, Nalanda wherein the petitioner in paragraph no. 1 of the said application, has prayed for other claims alongwith the claim of Gaddha (ditch).
In the 2nd supplementary affidavit also, it is stated that due to due to inadvertence and mistake some relevant facts has not been brought on record.

In para-4 thereof, it is stated that again on 04.12.2024, the petitioner has made a fresh representation claiming therein compensation of 8ft. Gaddha by cutting of soil and used in strengthening the embankment.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner prays for an adjournment of two weeks to file supplementary affidavit clarifying categorically as to what are the claims of the petitioner which has not been redressed.
4. As prayed for, list this matter on 20.01.2025.

(Alok Kumar Pandey, J) mcverma/-
